exposure: Tranexamic acid (TXA) combined with recombinant von Willebrand factor (rVWF)
cohort: Pregnant women aged 18 years or older with type 1 von Willebrand disease (VWD), specifically those with a VWF:RCo activity of <0.50 IU/mL and a history of bleeding.
finding: In this small pilot study, tranexamic acid combined with recombinant VWF was not associated with a reduction in quantitative blood loss or PPH rates compared to rVWF alone.
mod_finding: Stratified analyses showed no differences in outcomes based on delivery type.
